tasks.title: Shorter first-live-run path: servers plan T19 split into T19a (CSI only) and T19b, and a phase-1 rules-only decision runtime assembly
tasks.prTitle: docs(eng-harness): servers plan T19 split into T19a and T19b, phase-1 rules-only decision runtime assembly (B-475)
tasks.notes: Documents-only amendment across specs and plans of eng-harness (priority work item, on the first-live-run path). Background: on 2026-11-12 the owner reordered the build so that the first live run comes first (the model edit cycle on a copy of a real ETABS model through sasaah-csi-mcp, lead decision D-32) and told the lead to adopt the path and study a shorter one; the study is <lead>/reports/scenario-c.md (lead material, not a repository document; never cite it by path in the repository). Its verdict is to apply both reductions, and an independent refuter confirmed the substance but required corrections. Your job: apply the two 'Amendment' sections of that report (section 1: split of servers plan 0002 T19 into T19a, CSI-only port wiring, and T19b, the rest; section 2: a phase-1 rules-only `assemble_decision_runtime`, plan 0009 T10 into T10a and T10b, with the new acceptance criterion the report calls AC49 and the related spec 0006 Q16 note), WITH these mandatory corrections, which override the report where they differ: (1) The report was written before amendments B-465 (servers plan T12 split; T19 gained `_identity.py` and `_hostport.py`, budget 215) and B-471 (caller-chosen run id, `[decisions]` settings, the fixed signature of `assemble_decision_runtime`, plan 0006 T18 split into T18a and T18b, workflow registry on plan 0007 T9) merged. Start from the text on origin/build/v1 now, not from the YAML in the report: T19a keeps `_identity.py`, `_hostport.py` and the test file `test_csi_session_ops.py` and whatever else T19 lists today that the CSI path needs; measure a realistic budget for T19a (about 225 to 230 lines, including the H-G8 refusal of `[cli_tools.*]` settings at phase 1), within the 400 cap; T19b gets the remainder with its own files, tests_first, covers, depends_on and budget. (2) `point_policies` must NOT be allowed to be `None` in phase 1: a `None` binding would make the run report 'not available'. Define the phase-1 value explicitly (the mapping the rules-only assembly uses, as the current spec 0009 text and the B-471 signature allow) and say what T18a/T18b bind. (3) The new phase-1 acceptance criterion reports dropped releases as plain warning strings; it must not use the `ReleaseFinding` type, which belongs to the already merged evaluation store (plan 0009 T9) and is not what the phase-1 assembly returns. Check the merged code under packages/eng-harness/src/eng_harness/decisions/ before naming any type. (4) Where the split moves the SAFE adapter (plan F tasks T1 to T3) off the path, the T19b text must define the exact expected error of the SAFE stop that F.T3's tests-first test will assert (name the error code that exists in the contract; add none). (5) Every changed plan must still cover every acceptance criterion of its spec (GC016), every task stays within 400 lines, tests_first files belong to their own task (TF008), depends_on ids exist, and the cross-plan dependency prose of plans 0002, 0006, 0007, 0009 and 0010 agrees with the new task ids (search the whole design tree and the package docs for `T19` and `T10` references of these two plans and update each one that means the split task). (6) State in the plan prose which tasks leave the first-live-run path and when they return: servers S.T16 and S.T17, SAFE F.T1 to F.T3, providers P.T4, P.T6 and P.T7 return before the phase that first needs them (say which task depends on them). Do not delete or weaken any of those tasks. Do not change BUILD-STATUS.md, HANDOFF.md, LOCAL-TESTING.md, docs/build/ or ops/remaining-tasks.json (lead state files). In your final summary give the lead, as plain text: the new task ids with files and budgets, the exact list of tasks off the path, and two notes for the local testing guide (at the first live run the settings omit `[cli_tools.*]`; record mode is not available at the first run). Where a point cannot be applied without a decision the documents do not contain, do not decide: say so with the exact question. Keep to these edits (D-28). The pull request body line is `Plan-Task: none (spec and plan)`. Before you finish, run the gate for eng-harness as the playbook says for documents work items.
